source_claim: Toei Animation's official Recipippi page describes Recipeppi as a category of fairies inhabiting dishes and enumerates numerous distinct food-specific members. It does not establish that the generic tag recipipi identifies one exact Character for a single DIRECT_HOME relation.

checked_routes.result: The page defines Recipeppi as food fairies and lists many separate recipe-specific fairies; it does not identify the generic recipipi tag as one exact character.
The official series introduction refers to Recipeppi as cooking fairies in the plural and explains their story role, without resolving the generic tag's exact identity scope.

notes: Partial scope finding only; no negative or terminal HOME claim is made for recipipi. Six exact character positives are recorded in the companion authority batch.
